techniques.name: LLM Prompt Injection
techniques.desc: An adversary may craft malicious prompts as inputs to an LLM that cause the LLM to act in unintended ways.

techniques.name: LLM Prompt Injection: Direct
techniques.desc: An adversary may inject prompts directly as a user of the LLM.

techniques.name: LLM Prompt Injection: Indirect
techniques.desc: An adversary may inject prompts indirectly via a separate data channel that the LLM or AI agent ingests, such as text or multimedia pulled from documents, emails, databases or websites.

techniques.name: LLM Prompt Injection: Triggered
techniques.desc: An adversary may trigger a prompt injection via a user action or event that occurs within the victim's environment.

techniques.name: False RAG Entry Injection
techniques.desc: Adversaries may introduce false entries into a victim's retrieval augmented generation (RAG) database.

techniques.name: Training Data Poisoning
techniques.desc: Adversaries may manipulate data used for training or fine-tuning an AI model to influence the resulting model's behavior.

techniques.name: RAG Poisoning
techniques.desc: Adversaries may inject malicious content into data indexed by a retrieval augmented generation (RAG) system to contaminate a future thread through RAG-based search results.

techniques.name: AI Agent Context Poisoning
techniques.desc: Adversaries may attempt to manipulate the context used by an AI agent's large language model (LLM) to influence the responses it generates or actions it takes.

techniques.name: AI Agent Context Poisoning: Memory
techniques.desc: Adversaries may manipulate the memory of a large language model (LLM) in order to persist changes to the LLM across future chat sessions.

techniques.name: AI Agent Context Poisoning: Thread
techniques.desc: Adversaries may introduce malicious instructions into a chat thread of a large language model (LLM) to cause behavior changes which persist for the remainder of the thread.

techniques.name: AI Agent Tool Data Poisoning
techniques.desc: Adversaries may manipulate data in a victim-controlled, trusted, or connected data source that is accessible through an AI agent tool.

techniques.name: AI Agent Tool Poisoning
techniques.desc: Adversaries may poison tools used by AI agents by introducing or modifying malicious content or behavior in a tool's model-visible definition, executable implementation, or runtime responses.

techniques.name: AI Agent Tool Poisoning: Definition and Instructions
techniques.desc: Adversaries may poison the model-visible definition or operational instructions of an AI agent tool to manipulate how an agent interprets, selects, or invokes the tool.

techniques.name: AI Agent Tool Poisoning: Implementation
techniques.desc: Adversaries may poison the executable implementation of an AI agent tool so that normal tool invocation produces unauthorized behavior or hidden side effects.

techniques.name: AI Agent Tool Poisoning: Runtime Response
techniques.desc: Adversaries may poison the runtime response channel of a malicious or compromised AI agent tool by deliberately returning content intended to influence the model's subsequent reasoning, decisions, or actions.

techniques.name: User Execution: Poisoned AI Agent Tool
techniques.desc: A victim may invoke a poisoned tool when interacting with an AI agent.

techniques.name: Publish Poisoned AI Artifacts
techniques.desc: Adversaries may create or modify AI artifacts and publish them through public or shared distribution channels to facilitate compromise of downstream AI systems.

techniques.name: Publish Poisoned AI Artifacts: Datasets
techniques.desc: Adversaries may publish poisoned datasets intended for training or fine-tuning AI models.

techniques.name: Publish Poisoned AI Artifacts: Models
techniques.desc: Adversaries may publish poisoned AI models through model registries, code repositories, or other model distribution channels.

techniques.name: Publish Poisoned AI Artifacts: AI Agent Tools
techniques.desc: Adversaries may create and publish poisoned AI agent tools.

techniques.name: Manipulate AI Model: Modify AI Model Architecture
techniques.desc: Adversaries may directly modify an AI model's architecture to re-define it's behavior.

techniques.name: Manipulate AI Model: Modify Prompt Construction Logic
techniques.desc: Adversaries may modify templates, role delimiters, embedded system instructions, tokenizer settings, tool-call formatting, or other artifact-bundled logic that constructs the context sent to an AI model.

techniques.name: Modify AI Agent Configuration
techniques.desc: Adversaries may modify the configuration files for AI agents on a system.

techniques.name: Manipulate AI Model
techniques.desc: Adversaries may manipulate an AI model artifact or its bundled components to change AI system behavior, introduce malicious code, or establish persistent malicious functionality.

techniques.name: Manipulate AI Model: Poison AI Model
techniques.desc: Adversaries may manipulate an AI model's weights to change it's behavior or performance, resulting in a poisoned model.

techniques.name: Manipulate AI Model: Modify AI Model Architecture
techniques.desc: Adversaries may directly modify an AI model's architecture to re-define it's behavior.

techniques.name: Manipulate AI Model: Embed Malware
techniques.desc: Adversaries may embed malicious code into AI Model files.

techniques.name: Manipulate AI Model: Modify Prompt Construction Logic
techniques.desc: Adversaries may modify templates, role delimiters, embedded system instructions, tokenizer settings, tool-call formatting, or other artifact-bundled logic that constructs the context sent to an AI model.

techniques.name: LLM Trusted Output Components Manipulation
techniques.desc: Adversaries may utilize prompts to a large language model (LLM) which manipulate various components of its response in order to make it appear trustworthy to the user.

techniques.name: LLM Trusted Output Components Manipulation: Citations
techniques.desc: Adversaries may manipulate the citations provided in an AI system's response, in order to make it appear trustworthy.

techniques.name: Manipulate User LLM Chat History
techniques.desc: Adversaries may manipulate a user's large language model (LLM) chat history to cover the tracks of their malicious behavior.

techniques.name: LLM Jailbreak
techniques.desc: Adversaries may induce a large language model (LLM) to ignore, circumvent, or override its safety/alignment behaviors and/or guardrails to elicit outputs the model is intended to withhold.

techniques.name: Deploy AI Agent
techniques.desc: Adversaries may launch AI agents in the victim's environment to execute actions on their behalf.

techniques.name: Develop Capabilities: Autonomous Exploit Development
techniques.desc: An autonomous AI agent may identify a software vulnerability and develop or materially adapt an exploit capability with limited human direction.

techniques.name: Autonomous Reconnaissance
techniques.desc: Adversaries may use autonomous AI agents to conduct [Reconnaissance](/tactics/AML.TA0002) activities.

techniques.name: Autonomous Attack-Path Adaptation
techniques.desc: Adversaries may use an AI agent to autonomously construct and repeatedly revise an attack path toward an adversary-defined objective.

techniques.name: Autonomous AI Agent Communication
techniques.desc: Autonomous AI agents may exchange operational information with other AI agents, sub-agents, or independent agent runs.

techniques.name: Autonomous AI Agent Communication: Communication via Shared Artifacts
techniques.desc: Autonomous AI agents may communicate by creating or modifying artifacts in a shared resource that persists outside their individual execution contexts.

techniques.name: Autonomous AI Agent Communication: Direct Agent Communication
techniques.desc: Autonomous AI agents may communicate directly through agent-to-agent, sub-agent, or orchestrator interfaces.

techniques.name: Autonomous Attack Orchestration
techniques.desc: Adversaries may use autonomous AI systems as an operational control layer to manage multiple distinct autonomous agents or sub-agents toward a common adversary-defined objective.
